request.prompt:
Create exactly ONE isolated, full-body production prototype for Mass Effect — Armax Relay Clash, faithfully reproducing the specific original game model in the attached reference. Detailed realistic game-render finish and crisp readable silhouette, neutral studio illumination. Preserve the actual model proportions, surface materials, colors, equipment, anatomy and side-specific asymmetry. One subject and one view only; the reference sheet must not appear in the output. Keep all body parts and tips entirely inside the image with at least 6 percent transparent padding all around. Transparent RGBA background, no ground, no scene, no floor shadow, no text, no captions or logos. No redesign, no added equipment or invented effects. This is a static illustration, not an animation sheet.

Subject: the standard kett Ascendant from Mass Effect: Andromeda, using the SECOND view in the attached finalized BioWare sheet as the pose guide, in restrained levitation, angled slightly toward image-left. Faithfully preserve the gray, layered bony head with the dark smooth inset across its crown, recessed green eyes, olive-green high flared collar with small lateral points, dark gray segmented chest and abdomen, overlapping shoulder plates, slim long arms, violet-blue small emissive details, and the very long separate olive-green skirt-like armored panels surrounding the bent knees and split-toed boots. Preserve the exact placement and count of the floating-looking garment panels; all are attached clothing, no extra limbs. Arms relaxed as in the reference, fingers extended and complete. The entire levitating figure and every garment tip must fit with ample clear margin. Generate the character model only as documented: no separate orb, no shield sphere, no particle aura, no halo, no weapon.
